results.title: Military and Armed Groups in Mali Committing Human Rights Abuses Against Civilians
results.snippet: Human Rights Watch reported “indiscriminate” drone attacks conducted by the Malian military. The report documented one drone attack that destroyed part of a health facility and another that hit a market, killing six civilians and wounding at least 20. results.title: Mali drone kills 13 civilians, activists say; army says it targeted militants | AP News
results.snippet:
Malian armed forces and their allies have responded to mounting attacks by Islamist and separatist armed groups with abusive counterinsurgency operations in central and northern Mali that often harm civilians, Human Rights Watch said in a report earlier this month.

results.title: What Kidal Portends: JNIM, Islamic State, and the Sahelian Security Landscape - The Soufan Center
results.snippet: The attack on the Dioura military barracks in central Mali on September 10 killed at least 150 soldiers and, according to claims, 95 soldiers were kidnapped. This was followed by the September 24 attack on Djenné.
